ABS.meaning: Return the absolute value of one compatible numeric value.
ABS.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ACTION.meaning: Declare an executable operation or reference one ACTION declaration.
ACTION.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ACTUAL.meaning: Record the value observed by a TEST.
ACTUAL.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

AFTER.meaning: Require one execution unit to occur after named predecessors.
AFTER.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ALL.meaning: Require every listed Boolean condition to be TRUE.
ALL.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ALLOW.meaning: Grant permission for exact operations and targets without requiring execution.
ALLOW.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

AND.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ANY.meaning: Require at least one listed Boolean condition to be TRUE.
ANY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ASSERT.meaning: Contain the Boolean expression evaluated by a rule, check, goal, or test.
ASSERT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ASSUME.meaning: Declare an explicit conditional temporary value for otherwise unresolved data.
ASSUME.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

AUTHORITY.meaning: Assign source strength as an INTEGER from 0 through 1000; higher is stronger.
AUTHORITY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

BASE.meaning: Name the exact base type or parent definition from which a definition derives.
BASE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

BEFORE.meaning: Require one execution unit to occur before named successors.
BEFORE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

BOOLEAN.meaning: The scalar type containing TRUE and FALSE.
BOOLEAN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

BYTES.meaning: Represent or construct a non-negative exact byte count.
BYTES.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

CHECKSUM.meaning: Declare an exact integrity digest in algorithm:lowercase_hex form.
CHECKSUM.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

COMMENT.meaning: Contain non-normative text ignored by execution semantics.
COMMENT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

CONTAINS.meaning: Test exact membership in a string, collection, or object-key set.
CONTAINS.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

CONTENT.meaning: Contain exact text or data content.
CONTENT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

CONTEXT.meaning: Activate explicit supporting non-authoritative information for a scope.
CONTEXT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

COUNT.meaning: Return the number of members, fields, or Unicode code points in a value.
COUNT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DATA.meaning: Declare typed task material that is not interpreted as instructions.
DATA.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DATE.meaning: Represent or construct an RFC 3339 full-date value.

DATETIME.meaning: Represent or construct an RFC 3339 date-time with an optional offset; omission means UTC.

DECIMAL.meaning: An exact finite base-10 decimal scalar.
DECIMAL.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DEFAULT.meaning: Supply a value only when the target is MISSING and no stronger value exists.
DEFAULT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DEFINE.meaning: Create an immutable term, constant, type, operation, format, event, status, or error.
DEFINE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DELAY.meaning: Specify a bounded DURATION before a retry or follow-up action.
DELAY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DEPENDENCY.meaning: Declare or reference a prerequisite that must be satisfied before execution. In a kind.operation definition it declares the closed dependency classes the operation may select, defaulting to declared_state_only when omitted.
DEPENDENCY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DESCRIPTION.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DETERMINISTIC.meaning: Declare the determinism allowance of the fully resolved operation or selected profile set. TRUE asserts semantically equivalent results, effects, ordering, and status for identical declared inputs, dependency snapshots, selected profile-role bindings, and implementation versions; it is verified and never overrides nondeterminism. FALSE conservatively permits either deterministic behavior or bounded nondeterminism and never relaxes another rule.
DETERMINISTIC.contexts: Defined by grammar, block schemas, and determinism semantics.

DOMAIN.meaning: Name the technical subject area whose extension definitions apply.
DOMAIN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

DURATION.meaning: Represent or construct a non-negative elapsed time.
DURATION.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EACH.meaning: Bind one loop-local identifier to each member of a finite collection.
EACH.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ELSE.meaning: Open the branch used when the directly associated IF condition is FALSE.
ELSE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EMPTY.meaning: Return TRUE when a string or collection contains zero members.
EMPTY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ENCODING.meaning: Declare exact character or binary encoding.
ENCODING.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ENUM.meaning: A closed type containing exactly its declared values.
ENUM.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ERROR.meaning: Declare or reference an exact failure classification.
ERROR.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EVENT.meaning: Name the exact registered event that activates a handler. An event is raised only by an emitted diagnostic whose registered error declares that event.
EVENT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EVIDENCE.meaning: Declare or reference observable material supporting a check or result.
EVIDENCE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EXAMPLE.meaning: Contain a non-normative illustration unless a TEST explicitly evaluates it.
EXAMPLE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EXCLUDE.meaning: Remove exact entities from a SCOPE after INCLUDE selection.
EXCLUDE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EXECUTE.meaning: Select the single root task, phase, sequence, action, or test to perform.
EXECUTE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EXISTS.meaning: Return FALSE only for MISSING or an unresolved optional binding; UNKNOWN exists and returns TRUE.
EXISTS.contexts: Defined by the function registry and special-value semantics.

EXPECTED.meaning: Declare the exact value or condition expected by a TEST.
EXPECTED.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

EXTENSION.meaning: Load a versioned vocabulary extension that adds definitions only.
EXTENSION.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

FAILURE.meaning: Declare a terminal non-success condition or reference its result.
FAILURE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

FALLBACK.meaning: Name behavior used only when a primary handler operation cannot execute. It admits one HANDLER reference or one operation identifier that requires no named parameter and whose required target the handler-context binding supplies.
FALLBACK.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

FALSE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

FIELD.meaning: Declare one member of an OBJECT schema.
FIELD.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

FOR.meaning: Begin the bounded FOR EACH iteration form.
FOR.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

FORBID.meaning: Prohibit exact operations and targets as a hard rule.
FORBID.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

FORMAT.meaning: Declare exact representation of input, output, evidence, or content.
FORMAT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

GLOB.meaning: Represent or construct a workspace-relative file-selection pattern using the closed LCL GLOB profile.
GLOB.contexts: Defined by the type and constructor registries.

GOAL.meaning: Declare a required intended result or reference one GOAL declaration.
GOAL.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

HANDLER.meaning: Declare or reference deterministic behavior for one named event. A HANDLER block is an invocation site whose OPERATION is invoked under the ACTION operation contract, selected by the closed event model from EVENT and any WHEN condition.
HANDLER.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ID.meaning: Assign a unique lowercase namespaced identifier used for references.
ID.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

IF.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

IMPORT.meaning: Load one exact LCL document under a mandatory namespace.
IMPORT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

IN.meaning: Test membership or introduce the collection of FOR EACH.
IN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

INCLUDE.meaning: Select exact entities into a SCOPE before exclusions.
INCLUDE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

INPUT.meaning: Declare task input or reference one INPUT declaration.
INPUT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

INTEGER.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ITEM.meaning: Declare one member identifier of a user-defined ENUM.
ITEM.contexts: Repeatable only in DEFINE declarations with KIND kind.type and BASE ENUM; never an independent block or collection-value form.

ITEM_TYPE.meaning: Declare the element type of a LIST or SET.
ITEM_TYPE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

KIND.meaning: Select one defined document or declaration kind.
KIND.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

LCL.meaning: Open the mandatory language header of every document.
LCL.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

LIMIT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

LIST.meaning: An ordered collection that permits duplicate values and uses bracket value syntax.
LIST.contexts: Defined by the type and collection-value contracts.

LOSER.meaning: Reference the exact clause displaced by an OVERRIDE.
LOSER.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MATCHES.meaning: Test an entire STRING against a REGEX or an entire PATH/STRING against a GLOB.
MATCHES.contexts: Uses full-string semantics defined by the operator and pattern-profile registries.

MAX.meaning: Return the greatest comparable member of a non-empty collection.
MAX.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MAXIMUM.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MEANING.meaning: State the exact normative meaning of a DEFINE declaration.
MEANING.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MEASURE.meaning: Represent or construct a numeric value paired with one registered unit, including a time-category unit.
MEASURE.contexts: Defined by the typed-constructor and unit registries.

MEMORY.meaning: Activate explicit retained data for a scope without importing hidden rules.
MEMORY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MIN.meaning: Return the least comparable member of a non-empty collection.
MIN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MINIMUM.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MISSING.meaning: Mark an absent required value or unresolved required source.
MISSING.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

MODE.meaning: Select one exact behavior mode defined for the surrounding construct.
MODE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

NAME.meaning: Assign a human-readable label that is never used for reference resolution.
NAME.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

NAMESPACE.meaning: Assign the lowercase prefix for imported or extension definitions.
NAMESPACE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

NONE.meaning: Require every listed Boolean condition to be FALSE.
NONE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

NOT.meaning: Logical negation of the immediately following grouped or atomic expression.
NOT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

NULL.meaning: Represent an explicit known absence, distinct from MISSING and UNKNOWN.
NULL.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

OBJECT.meaning: A keyed value whose fields are declared by a schema or explicit data block.
OBJECT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

OPERATION.meaning: Name the exact built-in or extension operation invoked by an ACTION or HANDLER invocation site under the same operation contract.
OPERATION.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

OR.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

OUTPUT.meaning: Declare a produced result or reference one OUTPUT declaration.
OUTPUT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

OVERRIDE.meaning: Resolve one exact conflict by naming a WINNER and LOSER.
OVERRIDE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

PARAMETER.meaning: Declare one named typed operation input.
PARAMETER.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

PATH.meaning: Represent or construct an absolute path or a contained workspace-relative path.
PATH.contexts: Defined by the typed-constructor registry; resolved workspace paths cannot escape their WORKSPACE root.

PATTERN.meaning: Declare a GLOB or REGEX constraint.
PATTERN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

PERCENTAGE.meaning: Represent or construct a DECIMAL percentage from 0 through 100.
PERCENTAGE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

PHASE.meaning: Declare or reference a major ordered execution group.
PHASE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

PREFER.meaning: Declare a soft objective that cannot defeat a hard rule.
PREFER.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

PRESERVE.meaning: Require a target or properties to compare equal before and after execution.
PRESERVE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

PRIORITY.meaning: Order equally authoritative applicable clauses from -1000 through 1000; optional omission defaults to integer 0.
PRIORITY.contexts: Never inherited; an explicit value overrides the default, while a mandatory schema still requires the field.

PROPERTY.meaning: Name one exact property of a target or object.
PROPERTY.contexts: Legal only where an enclosing block schema admits PROPERTY; never an independent block.

PROVENANCE.meaning: Record exact origin and production method of data or evidence.
PROVENANCE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

REF.meaning: Resolve a declaration or loop-local binding by exact identifier.
REF.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

REFERENCE.meaning: Declare a typed pointer to another declaration.
REFERENCE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

REGEX.meaning: Represent or construct a conservative ECMAScript-compatible regular expression with optional canonical i, m, and s flags.
REGEX.contexts: Defined by the type and constructor registries.

REQUIRED.meaning: Declare whether an item is mandatory.
REQUIRED.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

REQUIRE.meaning: Declare a hard Boolean assertion or required ACTION.
REQUIRE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

RESULT.meaning: Declare or reference the value produced by a goal, operation, or test.
RESULT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

RETRY.meaning: Declare a bounded number of additional attempts after qualifying failure.
RETRY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

ROUND.meaning: Round a DECIMAL or MEASURE to non-negative fractional digits using half-even rounding; MEASURE preserves its UNIT.
ROUND.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

SCHEMA.meaning: Declare or reference the exact structure of an OBJECT value.
SCHEMA.contexts: Legal only where an enclosing block schema admits SCHEMA; never an independent block.

SCOPE.meaning: Declare or reference the exact set of entities to which a clause may apply.
SCOPE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

SEQUENCE.meaning: Declare or reference an ordered collection of steps.
SEQUENCE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

SET.meaning: An intrinsically unordered collection unique under strict equality using bracket value syntax; source or insertion order has no semantic meaning and equal duplicates collapse. Direct FOR EACH uses canonical ascending order only when actual members are mutually order-compatible; otherwise pass the SET directly to core.sort and iterate its LIST result.
SET.contexts: Defined by the type and collection contracts.

SIDE_EFFECT.meaning: Declare whether an operation may change external state and, when it may, the exact closed effect classes it can produce. FALSE declares possible effects exactly none; an effect-class LIST declares one or more concrete classes and forbids none.
SIDE_EFFECT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

SOURCE.meaning: Identify exact origin of data, import, context, memory, state, or evidence.
SOURCE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

SPECIFICATION.meaning: Declare mandatory identity and metadata of one LCL document.
SPECIFICATION.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

STATE.meaning: Declare explicit mutable external or project data read at a defined point.
STATE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

STATUS.meaning: Record one exact core or extension status identifier.
STATUS.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

STEP.meaning: Declare one ordered execution unit inside a phase or sequence.
STEP.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

STRING.meaning: A Unicode text sequence represented by an exact string literal.
STRING.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

SUCCESS.meaning: Declare the exact Boolean completion contract or reference it.
SUCCESS.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

SUM.meaning: Return the arithmetic sum of compatible numeric members.
SUM.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

TASK.meaning: Declare an executable task or reference one TASK declaration.
TASK.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

TARGET.meaning: Identify the exact entity affected, inspected, produced, or constrained.
TARGET.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

TERM.meaning: The DEFINE kind for one exact domain term.
TERM.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

TEST.meaning: Declare an executable comparison between expected and actual behavior.
TEST.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

THEN.meaning: Open the TRUE branch of the directly preceding IF.
THEN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

TIME.meaning: Represent or construct an RFC 3339 clock time with an optional offset; omission means UTC.

TOLERANCE.meaning: Declare an exact absolute permitted numeric difference.
TOLERANCE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

TRUE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

TYPE.meaning: Declare the data type of a value, member, parameter, input, or result.
TYPE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

UNIT.meaning: Declare one exact unit identifier associated with a MEASURE.
UNIT.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

UNKNOWN.meaning: Mark a value known to exist but not currently determinable.
UNKNOWN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

URI.meaning: Represent or construct an RFC 3986 absolute URI with a scheme.
URI.contexts: Defined by the typed-constructor registry; relative URI references are rejected.

VALIDATE.meaning: Check syntax, types, references, dependencies, and preconditions before effects.
VALIDATE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

VALUE.meaning: Contain one exact scalar, collection, object, expression, or reference.
VALUE.contexts: Legal only where an enclosing block schema admits VALUE; never an independent block.

VERIFY.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

VERSION.meaning: Declare one exact semantic version; ranges and latest are invalid.
VERSION.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

WHEN.meaning: Limit applicability to one explicit Boolean expression.
WHEN.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

WINNER.meaning: Reference the exact clause retained by an OVERRIDE.
WINNER.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.

WORKSPACE.meaning: Declare or reference an explicit base location for relative paths.
WORKSPACE.contexts: Defined by grammar and block schemas.
